subject.title: fix(security): add estimate-before-decode guard to base64 paths

question: Should OpenAI-compatible and Codex OAuth image generation fail closed per image at `generatedMediaMaxBytes`, including returning the existing missing-image error when every response entry exceeds that limit?
rationale: This is an intentional security/availability tradeoff that changes a previously accepted oversized-image result into a rejected response; code review cannot select the enduring user-facing contract without owner intent.

options.title: Accept per-image fail-closed guard
options.body: Approve the proposed configured per-image limit so oversized entries are rejected before allocation and all-oversized responses use the existing missing-image failure path.

options.title: Preserve aggregate-only acceptance
options.body: Keep the existing aggregate HTTP response cap and remove the per-image rejection from OAuth/OpenAI-compatible result parsing if compatibility outweighs the added allocation protection.

recommendation.title: Accept per-image fail-closed guard
recommendation.body: Approve the proposed configured per-image limit so oversized entries are rejected before allocation and all-oversized responses use the existing missing-image failure path.
